data.comment:
# Comfy Seedream 5.0 Lite- Text to Image

Input your text prompt to generate a detailed image. This workflow creates a visual representation of your description with precise control over style and layout. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_bytedance_seedream_5_0_lite_t2i.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: A beautiful woman, wearing an elegant red long dress, a wide-brimmed black straw hat, and bright red lips. Overlapping multi-layered plant shadows create a unique visual depth and dynamism. The main visual elements may have multiple different angles and transparencies to enhance the three-dimensionality and layering. The dark green background is simple, with a sense of art and storytelling. It is a poster integrated with shadow overlapping effects. The overall design is mysterious and full of artistic sense.
